_comment: Lab policy: a multi-signal policy for known and identifiable AI-assistance extensions (assistants, chat, model providers, AI code completion). Single source of truth: the Rust installer enforces it (src-tauri/src/commands/extensions.rs) and the UI labels with it (src/services/aiPolicy.ts). Text is lowercased, zero-width characters removed, fullwidth ASCII folded, and split into words on anything that is not a letter or digit. 'terms' match whole words/phrases. 'compactTerms' (distinctive names only) also match when broken up by spaces, punctuation or underscores ('Co-Pilot', 'chat gpt'); ordinary compounds such as 'black box' do not belong there. 'prefixes' match the start of any word or joined run of words. 'blockedIds' are exact extension IDs, also checked for extensionDependencies and extensionPack entries. 'manifestKeys' are contributes keys, 'apiProposalPrefixes' enabledApiProposals, 'activationEventPrefixes' activationEvents (all case-insensitive). Integration hooks that ordinary language extensions offer to AI tools (languageModelTools, MCP servers) are not blocked: CodeUI never runs extension code, so they are inert.
